base_url.description: Base URL where bepasty will be publicly accessible (including protocol, e.g., https://paste.example.com)

upload_dir.description: Absolute filesystem path where uploaded files are stored

secret_key.description: Random, cryptographically secure secret key used for signing sessions and tokens. Must be generated and kept secret.

public_enabled.description: Enable the public file upload form (anyone can upload if not rate-limited)

listing_enabled.description: Enable file listing for authenticated users (e.g., admins)

default_expiration.description: Default upload expiration time in seconds (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours). Use 0 for no expiration.

max_file_size.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes (e.g., 104857600 = 100 MB). Use 0 for unlimited.

allowed_mime_types.description: List of allowed MIME types. Empty list = allow all types. Example: ['text/plain', 'image/png', 'application/pdf']

inline_mime_types.description: List of MIME types that should be displayed inline in the browser instead of forcing download.

database_url.description: Database connection URI (SQLite, PostgreSQL, etc.). Example: 'postgresql://user:pass@localhost/bepasty'

host.description: IP address to bind the HTTP server to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: Port number for the HTTP server.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr instead.
